used.title: Ticket already checked in
used.detail: Check the event history for the earlier scan. If there's a dispute, ask the shift lead to verify it before admitting the guest.

wrongScope.title: Wrong event or showtime
wrongScope.detail: Check the event name and time on the ticket. Open the matching event and showtime in the app, then scan again.

locked.title: Ticket locked or missing
locked.detail: Ask the guest to open the original HaloTicket ticket. If the error persists, ask the organizer to verify the ticket status.

window.title: Outside the check-in window
window.detail: Verify the gate hours for this showtime with the organizer. Try again when the gate opens.

access.title: No check-in permission
access.detail: Check which account is signed in. Ask the organizer to verify your assignment for the event.

camera.title: Camera won't scan
camera.detail: Grant camera access in settings, clean the lens, brighten the ticket screen, and hold the QR code inside the scan frame.

network.title: Offline or system error
network.detail: Check Wi-Fi or mobile data and retry. Wait for the scanner to confirm the result before admitting the guest.
